finding: Data and figure publication policy conflicts with the blanket licence
evidence: The README permits a real QTIM example and applies CC BY to figures/results; the registry says real-case images never enter Git. CelebA source terms restrict research use and derived data. Aggregate/mean status alone does not settle the applicable permission.
smallest_remedy: Create a per-artifact dataset/licence/publication matrix; reconcile the QTIM exception; confirm which derived assets may carry the stated licence. Preserve provenance and do not re-host restricted raw data.

finding: Public entry-point claims are stronger than the measured evidence
evidence: The README moves from a variance-component model to unconditional mean/sibling and Dice conclusions. The paper correctly limits interpretation, registration remains provisional, and older c/rho/label results are withdrawn.
smallest_remedy: Rewrite the landing README around controlled metric/reference audits and current evidence status; label theoretical assumptions and synthetic mechanisms; link the frozen paper and withdrawn-results warning.

finding: A clean experiment environment is not specified or verified
evidence: Only manuscript requirements are installable. No root dependency/environment manifest exists. The advertised experiment runtime is Python 3.11; the executed 3.12 suite has one expected guard failure.
smallest_remedy: Provide separate pinned experiment, paper and optional-modality environments; test installation in a fresh Python 3.11 environment without weakening frozen guards.

finding: The default test command performs an unmarked model download and uses a Windows cache path
evidence: The full suite loaded pretrained AlexNet and produced a roughly 234 MB checkpoint beneath a literal C:\Projects\data directory in WSL. DATA_ROOT redirected the later runs to the ignored cache.
smallest_remedy: Separate offline unit tests from pretrained-model integration tests, mark the latter, document size/cache/network requirements and configure platform-neutral cache roots.

finding: The English-only publication requirement is not met by active generated material
evidence: Twenty tracked text files contain Cyrillic, including fifteen outside the explicitly historical Syncthing archive. Current generator strings can reintroduce Russian after a manual report translation.
smallest_remedy: Translate active publication text and generator strings together; keep original historical/quoted evidence explicitly identified rather than rewriting its content.

finding: The default branch and the reviewed research branch expose different project states
location: GitHub repository metadata; origin/master; codex/cvpr2027-manuscript; paper/cvpr2027/source_snapshot.py:12
evidence: The public fork defaults to master. The reviewed paper lives on the Codex branch and pins a48523d evidence while newer exports are present.
smallest_remedy: Choose and document a release entry point/tag, branch purpose and evidence manifest; update the default landing documentation through an author-approved fork change.

finding: Result JSONs contain non-standard NaN literals
evidence: Ten current result files contain 334 unquoted NaN constants. Python accepts them; strict JSON consumers need an explicit missingness representation.
smallest_remedy: Add a versioned strict export using null plus unavailable/undefined/not-run status and a schema. Preserve original historical result bytes and never replace missing values with zero.

finding: Automation and contributor release metadata are absent
evidence: No CI workflow or citation/contribution/security document was found. Repository security settings and branch protections were not inspected.
smallest_remedy: Add offline CI, an opt-in integration job, citation metadata, contribution/data-output rules and a private vulnerability-reporting route; verify settings separately.

finding: Ignore rules do not cover common credential and model-cache locations
evidence: external/ and common build files are ignored, but .env, key files, general data/cache directories and checkpoint extensions are not generally covered. No actual credential was detected by the limited scan.
smallest_remedy: Add scoped exclusions for local secrets, private data and weights, plus an outgoing-artifact check. Keep explicit exceptions for intentionally versioned public evidence.

finding: Newest exports need version-specific scientific integration and a unified status view
evidence: P3 is now present, H4 superiority is not established, and three H5 readouts mark interval_trusted false. The current paper intentionally uses P2. The metrics-board source does not cover all newer modality results.
smallest_remedy: Publish an evidence-version/status index and review P3/brain/face/IXI exports before updating claims. Keep point estimates, flagged uncertainty and not-run model experiments separate.

finding: Some realistic-looking illustrations need provenance at the asset entry point
evidence: The older photographic face ladder is documented as fictional ChatGPT imagery, not a participant photo. That explanation is in a separate document; the new bust has a stronger prompt/tool record.
smallest_remedy: Add an asset manifest and nearby synthetic/mean/template labels for every public visual; distinguish illustrations from measurements and dataset derivatives.

finding: Runtime and evidence provenance are sensitive to line endings and local paths
evidence: Nineteen source/cloud files include Windows path literals. Regenerating the board changed source byte hashes and CSV line endings without changing measured rows.
smallest_remedy: Use explicit configuration and record raw-byte and LF-normalized hashes where appropriate; add .gitattributes for new source/output conventions while retaining frozen original evidence.
